caption: The image is a drawing of a wooden chest with a rectangular shape and a flat lid, depicted in a three-quarters view against a plain, lightly yellowed background. The chest is brown in color with a wood grain texture visible on the main body and lid. The front of the chest is divided into three vertical panels, each with an arched top and surrounded by a narrow decorative border. The two outer panels each contain a stylized floral motif with blue, yellow, and green colors. The central panel features a more elaborate design, with a symmetrical animal figure, likely a deer, flanked by decorative elements in earthy tones. The top of the chest has additional painted decorations including a central circular motif with radiating lines and a dark shape toward the back right corner. The chest stands on four short legs and has a simple plinth base. In the lower left corner of the image is the handwritten name "Bernard Krieger" in black ink.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
